recommendation_profile.primary_thesis: Lotus Boulevard represents an exceptional value proposition in Sector 100 with proven delivery trust and strong secondary rental demand.
walk_away_conditions: Legal encumbrances on resale title deeds
recommendation_profile.timeline_advice: High liveability score, 80% open green podium, and walking access to daily conveniences.
negotiation_leverage: Leverage immediate payment liquidity to negotiate 3-5% discount on resale pricing.

decision_profile.decision_thesis: Lotus Boulevard represents an exceptional residential acquisition in Sector 100, balancing premium spatial efficiency, strong builder credibility, and immediate metro accessibility.
why_buy: Prime Connectivity: Located in Sector 100 with fast access to metro and major expressways.
Optimal Loading Factor: High usable carpet area to super area ratio compliant with RERA.
Rich Lifestyle Amenities: Olympic swimming pool, 50,000 sq ft clubhouse, and 80% green cover.
High Rental Yield: Consistently high rental demand from corporate executives working nearby.
why_avoid: High Demand Resale Competition: Peak secondary market prices during peak market waves.
Traffic at Peak Hours: Commute congestion on primary sector feeder roads during office rush hours.
Maintenance Surcharges: Premium clubhouse and elevator upkeep fees.
decision_profile.best_for: Nuclear and joint families seeking high-quality gated community living with high resale liquidity and top-tier builder delivery.
decision_profile.not_ideal_for: Buyers seeking low-cost budget housing without clubhouse amenity charges.

competitors.this_project_advantage: Superior open green percentage and larger balcony layouts.
competitors.verdict: Choose Lotus Boulevard for superior construction quality and clubhouse amenities.
